name: Supply Chain Guesser
description: Guess an everyday object from the global journey behind it.

store.tagline: Guess everyday objects by tracing their materials, makers, markets and afterlife.
store.description: A visual supply-chain guessing game about the hidden global journeys behind familiar objects. Compare material mass and value, explore raw-material sources, component and processing centers, producing countries, logistics hubs, buyers and end-of-life destinations, then identify the mystery object in five guesses. Each miss reveals a progressive built-in clue, while signed-in Möbius installations can optionally ask an AI reviewer to reconsider unusual synonyms or matching subtypes. Includes twelve independently playable objects, responsive layouts, selectable map layers and clear data-limit notes throughout.
